# Isaiah Chapter 55 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 13 verses]*

*Come to the waters; seek the LORD; word shall not return empty; mountains and hills sing; peace*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, declares the LORD. This chapter come to the waters.

*-- LOGOS*
